findings.title: Compact failures discard captured usage
findings.description: The SDK session attaches telemetry to `ProviderError` when dispatch fails, but this handler catches the exception and returns an `ActionResult` without recording or stamping that telemetry. As a result, spend before a failed compact dispatch is omitted from run state and `sq stats run` totals.

findings.title: Split-review totals omit all but the first part
findings.description: Each successful part now stamps its own usage record, but the multi-part path folds those results through `fold_review_parts`, whose metadata aggregation keeps only the first part’s metadata. The persisted step therefore loses the usage records for later parts, undercounting tokens, cost, and turns for split reviews.

findings.title: Provider failure in a split review can break result folding
findings.description: On a provider error, `_run_part` now returns a failed result rather than re-raising. For a multi-part review, the caller continues collecting results and passes them to `fold_review_parts`; a non-judge failure result has no verdict, which folding rejects with `TypeError`. The outer handler then returns a generic failure result, also losing the failed part’s usage record.
